user.title: Set up Switch Vision
user.description: Create the Switch Vision integration entry. Existing calibration profiles and generated dashboard configuration are preserved.

init.title: Switch Vision Core settings
init.description: Configure shared Switch Vision Core dashboard behaviour. Activity LED settings apply integration-wide to Native, Community, and custom Switch Vision cards.

data.reset_to_defaults: Reset all Switch Vision Core settings to defaults

data_description.reset_to_defaults: When enabled, saving this form restores every Switch Vision Core option on this page to the v2.2 factory defaults.

data.show_panel_in_sidebar: Show automatic Native Switch Vision panel in sidebar
data.show_lovelace_dashboard_in_sidebar: Show Switch Vision Lovelace dashboard in sidebar
data.show_calibration_buttons: Show calibration buttons on switch cards

data_description.show_panel_in_sidebar: Show or hide the automatic Native Switch Vision panel at /switch-vision.
data_description.show_lovelace_dashboard_in_sidebar: Show or hide Home Assistant dashboards created with the Switch Vision Community dashboard strategy.
data_description.show_calibration_buttons: Show or hide the on-card Calibration button on the automatic generated Switch Vision dashboard.
data_description.show_dashboard_header: Show or hide the native dashboard summary row containing switch count, last-generated status, Refresh, and version.
data_description.show_card_headers: Show or hide the complete header row on every Switch Vision card, including custom YAML cards.

activity_leds.name: Activity LEDs
activity_leds.description: Activity LED 2.0 maps measured RX + TX throughput to negotiated link utilisation. Presets control when Medium and Fast activity begin; Custom uses the two threshold fields below.

data.activity_slow_max_utilization_pct: Custom: Medium starts at link utilisation (%)
data.activity_medium_max_utilization_pct: Custom: Fast starts at link utilisation (%)

data_description.activity_led_sensitivity_preset: Low is calmer, Normal is the v2.2 default, High reacts to very light traffic, and Custom uses your utilisation thresholds.
data_description.activity_slow_max_utilization_pct: Used only with Custom. Below this utilisation the LED uses the Slow band.
data_description.activity_medium_max_utilization_pct: Used only with Custom. At or above this utilisation the LED uses the Fast band.
data_description.activity_slow_period_ms: Time for one complete Slow blink cycle. Larger values blink more slowly.
data_description.activity_medium_period_ms: Time for one complete Medium blink cycle.
data_description.activity_fast_period_ms: Time for one complete Fast blink cycle. Minimum supported value is 120 ms.
data_description.activity_hold_seconds: Keeps the last detected activity visible between telemetry samples. The default 12 seconds is tuned for the current 10-second traffic cadence.
data_description.activity_hysteresis_pct: Adds a buffer around utilisation thresholds so activity does not rapidly jump between Slow, Medium, and Fast near a boundary.

discovery.name: Switch Vision Discovery
discovery.description: Shared presentation controls read by supported Switch Vision Discovery versions.

data.show_unifi_integration: Show UniFi2MQTT integration in Switch Vision Hub

data_description.discovery_ui_density: Comfortable uses generous spacing; Compact fits more onscreen; Dense maximizes visible information.
data_description.discovery_text_size: Normal uses the standard Discovery text size; Small uses reduced typography.
data_description.discovery_content_width: Standard uses the original width; Wide expands the workspace; Full uses the available browser width.
data_description.show_unifi_integration: Show or hide the UniFi2MQTT section in Switch Vision Hub.

data_description.installer_content_width: Controls content width in supported Switch Vision Installer versions.

error.invalid_activity_thresholds: Custom Activity LED thresholds must place the Medium threshold below the Fast threshold.
error.invalid_activity_periods: Activity LED blink periods must be ordered Fast ≤ Medium ≤ Slow.
